brand_identity.name: Invovix
brand_identity.niche: Smart home (domotique) & premium remote work tech
brand_identity.vibe: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day, editorial, premium, highly technical yet accessible, brutalist elegance.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl+ tracking-tighter leading-none font-black uppercase

typography.instructions: CRITICAL: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Headings must be tightly tracked. Apply extreme weight contrast (Black vs Light).

colors.rules: No full-screen gradients. Color is function only. The UI should be 90% monochrome with the brand accent (#FF3300) used strictly for kinetic moments and primary CTAs.

grids_and_layouts.global_spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-24, py-32 for vertical rhythm.
grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Asymmetrical spans. Example: The Hero (col-span-8), The Square (col-span-4).
grids_and_layouts.product_catalog: Cardless, technical grid layout (border-collapse style). 1px solid borders separating items. Sharp edges, max 4px radius for UI elements.
grids_and_layouts.container_rules: Elements with borders MUST have internal padding (e.g., p-6 or p-8).

visual_enhancers.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70, border-b border-black/5. CRITICAL: Never fully transparent.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Sharp rectangular or fully pill-shaped. High contrast hover states (e.g., hover:bg-brand_accent hover:text-white).
visual_enhancers.hero_overlay: Max overlay bg-black/30. The hero image is a premium asset, let it breathe.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise/grain overlay utility class to kill digital flatness on dark sections.

motion.hero_reveal: Signature on-load moment: Kinetic line-by-line text reveal using framer-motion (y-axis translation with overflow-hidden mask on text lines).
motion.scroll: Smooth momentum scrolling via Lenis is MANDATORY on the root layout.
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee (react-fast-marquee) for the brand manifesto. High contrast, large uppercase font.
motion.interactions: Hover scale-up for product images. Micro-interactions on buttons. Page transitions.

components.marketing_sections: HTML/Tailwind (div, section) to achieve overlapping, non-standard layouts. Do not restrict to rigid Shadcn cards.
components.interactive_logic: Shadcn UI (Forms, Select, Tabs, Dialogs) Heavily customized to strip the 'Vercel-look'.
components.admin_dashboard: Use tight bento grids, dense data displays, and pure functional utility. High contrast for data legibility.
components.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='checkout-paypal-btn').

media_and_3d.3d_strategy: Subtle parallax on hero images using framer-motion. Keep the focus on premium product photography rather than heavy WebGL, ensuring fast e-commerce load times.
media_and_3d.images: Use deliberate spotlighting, clipped frames for products.

smart_home_hero.description: Premium desk setup for tech/remote work vibe. Good for 'Workspace' category or Hero section.

product_catalog_placeholders.description: Smart home devices flat lay (bulbs, sensors). Use for smart home product grids.
Minimalist smart camera and tech. Use for security category.

manifesto_background.description: Moody, dark remote workspace setup. Excellent background for the numbered manifesto chapters.

instructions_to_main_agent: NEVER use generic placeholder texts. The site is bilingual (FR/EN) - build standard language switcher logic.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main Layout wrapper to give a premium feel.
Create a numbered manifesto section with large overlapping typography (e.g., '01. The Connected Home', '02. Seamless Integration').
Hero section MUST feature the framer-motion kinetic line-by-line reveal for the H1 on load.
Products must be displayed in a curated, editorial grid with sharp 1px borders, not a basic padded bootstrap grid.
Header must use backdrop-blur-xl and NEVER be fully transparent.
Admin dashboard must be protected by auth, featuring an overview of orders and product management.
Ensure both Stripe and PayPal are visually integrated into the checkout flow.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs ('AI slop'). Break the rules carefully to create an Awwwards aesthetic.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions (transform, opacity).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (sharp or pill-shaped) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for robust automated testing.
